plain: A governor ruling a colony in the name of a king

webster.text: The governor of a kingdom or country, who rules in the name of the king with regal authority, as the king's substitute.

example.quote: This would be putting it in the power of the States to say, "You shall be viceroys but we will be viceroys over you"-
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, August 24, 1787
